no_physical_zero_padding.evidence: Inspection of tensor shapes and collate_structural_graphs confirmed zero spatial padding nodes. Total batch nodes equal exact sum of floor counts.

ood_a_earthquake_isolation.evidence: RSN0011 and RSN0012 have exactly 0 samples in train, val, and ID test partitions across all 2,160 rows in split_manifest.csv.

ood_b_structural_isolation.evidence: Structural archetype 5S_T120 has exactly 0 samples in train, val, and ID test partitions. Evaluated on 240 completely unseen simulations.

training_only_scaler.evidence: GraphNormalizer fitted strictly on train_df (1,080 samples) before training loop execution.

ood_b_rel_l2_error.evidence: Recomputed independently from ood_b_results.csv. Plausibility verified via FFT dominant frequency analysis showing modal period extrapolation phase drift.

topology_ablation.evidence: Verified between best_checkpoint.pt and best_ablation_no_topology.pt. Modest effect size on single seed.

inference_speedup.evidence: Verified from inference_benchmark.csv and raw MPS re-run.

exp4_comparison.evidence: The 180 3-story test simulations are 100% identical between EXP4 and EXP5. However, claiming a 77.5% 'absolute error reduction' is phrasing error: it is a 77.51 percentage-point reduction and a 77.82% relative error reduction.

investigation_ood_b_125pct.root_cause: The training set only contains structures with T1 <= 0.85s (for 5S) and T1 <= 0.90s (for 3S). When presented with T1 = 1.20s, the model predicts the correct displacement envelope (peak error ~15%) but its temporal Fourier modes default towards the upper bound of the training period envelope (~0.89s). Two sinusoidal oscillations of equal amplitude at 1.12 Hz and 0.83 Hz rapidly drift out of phase, yielding a mathematical relative L2 error of sqrt(2) approx 141%, consistent with the observed 125-132%.

minor_issues.issue: Language imprecision in comparing EXP4 vs EXP5 3-story results
minor_issues.description: Report described 99.60% to 22.09% as a '77.5% absolute error reduction'. It is a 77.51 percentage-point reduction and a 77.82% relative reduction.
minor_issues.correction: Adopt precise metrology terminology: 'reduced by 77.51 percentage points (77.82% relative reduction)'.

minor_issues.issue: Batched GNO latency higher than single-sample latency on Apple Silicon MPS
minor_issues.description: Single sample GNO takes 15.82 ms/sim while B=32 takes 20.25 ms/sim on MPS due to 128-node complex einsum scaling.
minor_issues.correction: Document that single-sample inference is the optimal serving configuration for GNO on Apple Silicon unified memory.
